 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Texas high school football playoffs kicked off Thursday, Nov. 12, with several Wichita Falls-area teams advancing to the second round while others saw their seasons end.
 Windthorst, Jacksboro and Muenster were among the area's top-ranked teams to advance, while Knox City and Harrold also secured convincing victories in their postseason openers.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The seventh-ranked Trojans defeated Quanah 61-20, while No. 8 Jacksboro cruised past Grape Creek 55-13. Sixth-ranked Muenster held off Hawley 48-40 in one of the night's closest contests.
 Here are Thursday's bi-district playoff results from across Texoma.
